user.title: Set up Vattenfall InCharge
user.description: Create a local Vattenfall InCharge session for public charging stations and optional MyCharge account data.

add_first_station.title: Add first charging point
add_first_station.description: Add a charging point by name, for example AB1234 or XY6789. You can find the charging point name in the Vattenfall InCharge app. Leave this empty to skip this step and add one later. Vattenfall InCharge stations are fully supported. Other networks are partially supported.

add_first_mycharge_account.title: Add MyCharge account
add_first_mycharge_account.description:
Open the MyCharge login URL below in your browser, complete the login and OTP flow, then paste the full final callback URL here. Leave this empty to skip this step and add a MyCharge account later from Configure.

{auth_url}

add_charging_point.title: Add charging point
add_charging_point.description: Add a charging point by name, for example AB1234 or XY6789. You can find the charging point name in the Vattenfall InCharge app. Vattenfall InCharge stations are fully supported. Other networks are partially supported.

remove_charging_points.title: Remove charging point
remove_charging_points.description: Select one or more configured stations to remove.

mycharge_account.title: Add MyCharge account
mycharge_account.description:
Open the MyCharge login URL below in your browser, complete the login and OTP flow, then paste the full final callback URL here. If your browser shows an error after login, copy the URL from the address bar or browser error message.

{auth_url}
